correctness.rationale: The two chain interaction conditions are exactly equivalent to monotonicity of row maxima and column maxima: applying each quantified condition to the current maximum gives necessity, while choosing the later row or column maximum gives sufficiency. For fixed nondecreasing maxima a,b, every edge must lie in A(a,b), every stated row/column maximum must lie in F(a,b), and the two compatibility inequalities are exactly the condition F subset A. Hence each admissible maxima pair contributes 2^(|A|-|F|) relations independently. The exact-commit verifier was inspected in full: it tests the source conditions against the maxima criterion for every relation through n=4 and separately sums all admissible maxima pairs through n=6, obtaining 2,9,118,4849,697066,378458905. The finite checks support, rather than replace, the symbolic proof.
